subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be scoped to documenting the current pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable TUI send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: Current main already gets partial newline composition from pi-tui, but configurable send/newline behavior would add a public keybinding/config surface where repository policy requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Document current behavior first
options.body: Update TUI docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable bindings to an explicit follow-up decision.

options.title: Approve a TUI keybinding bridge
options.body: Wire pi-tui keybinding configuration into openclaw tui with focused tests, docs, and compatibility-safe configuration behavior.

options.title: Close as sufficient
options.body: Treat dependency-level newline support as enough and explicitly decline docs/help/config follow-up for this issue.

recommendation.title: Document current behavior first
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable bindings to an explicit follow-up decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current-main TUI/docs history and prior scope review make them the best available owner for the product-scope decision.
